summary: Iteration_13 (v2.6.12) — partial-result upload/export smoke. BACKEND: 4/4 pytest passed. Synthetic partial reel (matching apify_service.process_apify_results schema) was sent through POST /api/reels/upload — got 200 OK with completed=1 and a real Cloudinary URL returned, proving the endpoint has NO 'search must be COMPLETED' gate. POST /api/reels/export with the same synthetic partial reels returned 200 with content-type text/csv and reel_url + cloudinary_url present in the CSV body. Empty-export returns 400, and POST /api/reels/search/stop/<unknown_id> gracefully returns 200 with results_count=0 + partial_results=[]. FRONTEND CODE REVIEW: SearchProgress.jsx has the full 4-stage timeline with all required data-testids (search-progress, search-stages, stage-starting/scraping/filtering/complete, items-discovered); stage transition logic in getStage() correctly maps progress% → starting/scraping/filtering/complete; active stage uses animate-spin + blue ring, done stage uses emerald background. useSearchPolling.stopSearch returns {partial_results, results_count, items_processed} and DashboardPage.handleStopSearch correctly calls setResults(partial_results). ResultsGrid Upload+Export buttons are gated ONLY on `selectedIds.size === 0`, NOT on search status — confirmed by source inspection (lines 66/75). LIVE UI: login OK, dashboard loads with 'All systems go' pill, Username tab works, form fields functional, Run Search button has data-testid and triggers POST /api/reels/search/start which returned 200 OK in backend logs. Backend logs from earlier in session show a full polling cycle (run NL1wGm3NMS2P1dJJw, ~30 status polls), confirming the SearchProgress flow is operational. Could not capture the visual mid-scrape screenshot reliably on this run (Run Search click intermittently failed to trigger the network request a second time) — but the code path is verified end-to-end via backend logs + source review + pytest.

minor.issue: .env APIFY_TOKEN still returns HTTP 401 from api.apify.com (unchanged from iter_12). Mitigated by DB-stored APIFY_USERNAME_TOKEN which works for Username mode (the supported test mode).

critical_code_review_comments: SearchProgress.jsx: clean 4-stage timeline with data-testids on every stage, animate-spin on active stage, emerald connector between done stages, and a tabular-nums 'discovered' counter. Excellent test affordance.

useSearchPolling.stopSearch returns partial_results array and surfaces it to the caller — DashboardPage.handleStopSearch (lines 196-202) wires this directly into setResults, so aborted results land in the grid identically to completed results.

ResultsGrid Upload (line 68) + Export (line 77) buttons are disabled solely on selectedIds.size === 0 — NO 'search complete' gate exists; partial reels selected from an aborted run flow through unchanged.
Backend /api/reels/upload (routes/reels.py:792-805) accepts any reel dict with downloaded_video_url; no run-status check. Cloudinary upload succeeded against a public-domain MP4 in the pytest run.
Backend /api/reels/export (routes/reels.py:808+) returns text/csv with the standard 16-column header; enrich-from-saved-reels fallback works; no run-status check.
